A controlled benchmark should compare the same content, browser, and target language so that request scheduling is the only meaningful difference between runs.

The first visible result matters to the reader, while the final viewport completion time shows whether the entire translation flow actually became faster.

Repeated measurements reduce the chance that one unusually fast or slow provider response determines the production configuration.
